summary_en: This Phase 2 study tests decitabine and selinexor added to carboplatin and paclitaxel in people with relapsed or treatment-resistant epithelial ovarian, fallopian tube or primary peritoneal cancer. Treatment uses 28-day cycles: decitabine by IV on days 1 to 5, carboplatin and paclitaxel on day 6, and paclitaxel again on days 13, 20 and 27, with selinexor 60 mg by mouth weekly from day 7 in cycles 2 to 6 (cycle 1 is given once). The study measures side effects, tumor response, immune cell changes, disease progression and overall survival; the primary outcome is not stated.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 2 evalúa decitabina y selinexor añadidos a carboplatino y paclitaxel en personas con cáncer epitelial de ovario, de trompa de Falopio o peritoneal primario recurrente o resistente al tratamiento. El tratamiento se administra en ciclos de 28 días: decitabina por vía intravenosa los días 1 a 5, carboplatino y paclitaxel el día 6, y paclitaxel nuevamente los días 13, 20 y 27, con selinexor 60 mg por vía oral una vez por semana desde el día 7 en los ciclos 2 a 6 (el ciclo 1 se administra una sola vez). El estudio mide los efectos secundarios, la respuesta del tumor, los cambios en las células inmunitarias, la progresión de la enfermedad y la supervivencia global; el resultado principal no se indica.
who_for: Adults 18 years or older with good performance status (ECOG 2 or better)
Epithelial ovarian, fallopian tube or primary peritoneal cancer that relapsed or progressed after platinum and taxane treatment
Measurable disease by GCIG CA125 criteria
Adequate liver and kidney function, and able to swallow and keep down oral medicines
Stable CNS metastases treated with radiotherapy are allowed
not_for: Previous treatment with selinexor or another XPO1 inhibitor
Known intolerance, hypersensitivity or contraindication to platinum or taxane therapy
Myocardial infarction within 3 months before starting, or unstable cardiovascular disease
Blood clot related to metastatic disease that needs ongoing anticoagulation
